verdict.rationale: Wise's docs explicitly describe how businesses without financial licenses can offer accounts to their customers. Supporting APIs cover account creation in 160+ countries, multi-currency accounts holding up to 56 currencies, claim-account ownership transfer, and Wise-hosted embedded flows that partners can iframe or WebView into their own product. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the licensing/regulatory model (who carries KYC and compliance obligations), and independent or hands-on corroboration that partners have shipped embedded accounts this way.
